Author: Lucas Li
Message:
Add alert runbooks, availability and recovery-point SLOs

- Every alert (23 per instance, 3 for the operator) carries runbook_url
  from spec.monitoring.runbookBaseURL / --runbook-base-url and has a
  runbook in docs/runbooks/ (meaning, impact, confirm, causes, fix,
  escalate).
- Availability SLI
  forgejo_operator_availability_probes_total{result,planned} sampled
  every interval, counting no-Ready-pod time as down and
  maintenance/upgrades/pauses/first install as planned (held restores
  are unplanned). SLO spec.monitoring.slo with recording rules and
  SRE-workbook multiwindow burn-rate alerts scaled to the window and
  probe interval; RPO of two backup intervals for local and remote
  backups. SLO panels in the dashboard.
- make test-rules: promtool check/test via prom/prometheus, with Go
  tests enforcing runbooks, firing and non-firing cases and fresh rule
  files.
- HA notes: server-pod-only health restarts, throttled Sentinel checks,
  Valkey reset after restores/rollbacks, no spurious ValkeyFailedOver,
  password changes replace Valkey pods together, LKG declined when the
  Valkey URL changed.

Verified on a local cluster: 41/41 runbook/SLO checks (outage fires the
fast burn in under a minute, planned restore fires nothing).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Lucas Li
Message:
Add ForgejoRunner for Actions runners with declarative registration

A ForgejoRunner (fjrn) runs forgejo-runner 13.2 as a StatefulSet, one
registration per pod, scoped to the instance, an organization or a
repository. Registration is a Job running forgejo-cli actions register
with the instance's own image and app.ini (no exec, no admin token,
secrets only in <r>-tokens; output masked); unregistering on scale-down
and deletion uses the admin API by id with a bounded finalizer.

Executors (required, no default): docker (privileged dind native sidecar
on a Unix socket; PodSecurityBlocked condition when the namespace
forbids it) and host (restricted-compatible, toolchain image). Status
lists registered runners; metrics and a ForgejoRunnersOffline alert.
Scaling no longer restarts surviving runner pods; a runner missing in
Forgejo is re-registered under the same UUID.

Verified on a local cluster against Forgejo 15 and 17: 49/49 checks
(docker build in jobs, restricted host runners, org scoping, no ghosts
on scale-down/deletion, artifacts in object storage, no leaked secrets).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Lucas Li
Message:
Add S3 storage and encrypted off-cluster backups with disaster recovery

Object storage (spec.objectStorage): LFS, attachments, avatars, repo
avatars, repo archives, packages and Actions logs/artifacts on an
S3-compatible bucket, credentials only as secretKeyRef env (never in
app.ini), optional CA, ObjectStorageReady from a signed bucket probe;
autopilot and upgrades hold while the bucket is unusable.

Remote backups (spec.backup.remote): after the local backup, an rclone
crypt upload (streamed, multipart, read-back SHA-256) to
<backup>-<uid8>/ with manifest.json written last; identity.json carries
<name>-secrets, admin and SSH host keys and the spec. Generated
<name>-backup-key is never rotated, BackupHealthy stays False until it
is marked exported. Remote retention prunes only this instance's
Scheduled backups. ForgejoRestore can restore by remote path, and
spec.restoreFrom bootstraps a new instance from a remote backup
(identity first, then DB and data, refusing non-empty targets).

Verified on a local cluster with Garage (hack/s3-lab): 52/52 checks
including a full-namespace DR drill on Forgejo 17 and remote restore
on 15.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Author: Lucas Li
Message:
Automate new Forgejo releases: saved workflow and committed checklists

.claude/workflows/forgejo-new-version runs make forgejo-versions,
researches the release, applies the docs/versions.md procedure, verifies
with test/e2e/checklists/versions.md on a local cluster, and reviews
(Sonnet for detection and checklist runs, Opus for research,
implementation, fixes and review). The capability-level and version
checklists are now in the repo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Discovered a potential basic authorization token provided in a curl command, which could compromise the curl accessed resource.
Match:
curl -s -u "$U:$P" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST $B/api/v1/admin/users -d '{"username":"alice","email":"alice@example.com","password":"Alice-Passw0rd-2026","must_change_password":false}'` (201).
